title: No Longer Human
author: Osamu Dazai
summary: A man writes three notebooks about his life, describing how he has pretended to be a clown to hide his fear of other people. His years of drink, debt and failed attempts to belong gradually wear him down.
readIf: you like short, bleak literary fiction about alienation, told in a raw, confessional voice.
skipIf: you are in a fragile place or want a hopeful book, as it is relentlessly sad.

pairings.reason: Another confessional novel about a narrator who feels disconnected and slowly loses her grip.
A short, spare novel about a man who cannot perform the feelings others expect of him.
A lighter, drier Japanese story about someone who does not fit social norms.
